title: Successive Selector Prefixes
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let $m$ be a natural number with $m<\mathrm{nbits}(M)$ and $m<|y|$. Updating the $m$-bit selector prefix of $y$ at coordinate $m$ to the bit $y_m$ gives the $(m+1)$-bit selector prefix of $y$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Boolean Turing machine M
